## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes offline
- [ ] `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` passes (after hooks installed)
- [ ] Conventional commit message / PR title
- [ ] No `data/packs/`, `data/cache/`, `.env`, or large binaries committed
- [ ] If `MissionIntent` or catalog schema changed: RFC linked (`needs-rfc`)
- [ ] If OSM / DEM / Sentinel handling changed: attribution / NOTICE considered (ODbL / Copernicus)
- [ ] Docs updated when user-facing behavior changes
